# LinkDraw

> LinkDraw is a free, local-first web application for organizing Excalidraw canvases and connecting related ideas.

LinkDraw helps people build multi-canvas visual workspaces. Users can organize drawings in a hierarchy, link whole drawings or specific elements and frames, navigate those links, and inspect relationships in a graph view.

## Important facts

- LinkDraw runs in the browser and requires JavaScript.
- Drawing data is stored locally in the user's browser by default; LinkDraw does not publish or expose individual user drawings as public web pages.
- It is intended for visual thinking, diagramming, knowledge mapping, and connected canvas workflows.
- The application integrates the Excalidraw canvas experience.

## Canonical URL

- https://link-draw.com/

## Core capabilities

- Create, rename, duplicate, organize, and delete drawings in a tree.
- Link a drawing to another drawing, an element, or a frame.
- Follow links with focused navigation and highlights.
- Explore relationships between drawings in a graph.
- Save work automatically to local browser storage.
